newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's airforce commander General Ion Stan and captain commandor Petre Gheorghe died on Wednesday when their small plane crashed on a training flight near the western city of Timisoara.

* Germany's support for Romania's bid to join NATO in a first wave of expansion, is expected to be fully expressed during a visit by Romanian president Emil Constantinescu to Bonn on July 2, the foreign ministry said.
* Romania, Ukraine and Moldova experts will meet on June 16 to discuss a calendar on trilateral cooperation.
* Poland's Foreign Minister to start a visit to Bucharest on Thursday. He will meet Constantinescu and Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea.
* Romanian Foreign Minister Adrian Severin will visit Israel on June 15-16 to boost bilateral ties. During the visit Severin is expected also to meet Yasser Arafat.

* The Senate's Foreign Policy Commmision is hearing Severin on the recently signed treaty between Romania and Ukraine. Severin said the hearing was a standard procedure ahead of parliament's ratification of the treaty.
